Standing independently inspected matching-material/function/unit disposal and geographic-proxy approvals, applied only after matching the declared wet composition, biogenic-carbon fraction, treatment class, actual cement/residue/facility coordinates and opposite one-kg waste/service reference signs for the enumerated pilot cases. limitations: Preserve signed waste kg with factor -1 because source waste production is -1kg and native service production is +1kg. Preserve burdens/credits, lognormal uncertainty, symbolic formulas, caller ownership and separately listed transport/materials/emissions. Apply no absolute-value, density, moisture, yield or recovery factor.

Use complete native collection/sorting services, including existing internal freight and final disposal where documented, once. Native freight can be absent as a direct source exchange; do not add a second freight burden. No recovered product, virgin-material credit, reconstructed source emissions or additional landfill process is invented.

Collection endpoints retain the same named waste and inert/construction-landfill function, but their native model includes explicit long-term leachate, infrastructure and operational updates while legacy source endpoints omit direct leachate. Native composition/moisture, model horizon, geography, background, vintage and biosphere coverage differ. Retain these as screening limitations, including native imported exclusions; no inventory/LCIA equality is established.

Only enumerated cut-off source profiles are registered. Concrete sorting that routes residue to clinker and PE/PP collection with global mixed treatment fates are excluded from this decision; do not redirect those routes to landfill or all-incineration without separate resolution. Independent inverse and cross-system-model routes remain unsupported.
